title: Austin: Fines, Dam Land, and Telegraph Lines
summary:
*   **Leniency for Citizens:** The City Council suspended outstanding court fines for four individuals (Mary Johnson, Bessie Gray, Lillie Fields, and Julia Hubbard) conditional on their good behavior.
*   **Colorado River Dam Impact:** Approved the purchase of "overflow rights" for $300 from John A. Darter, allowing the city to flood parts of his land due to a dam being built on the Colorado River.
*   **Utility Expansion:** Granted Western Union Telegraph Company permission to dig up city streets (West 6th and Colorado) to install new underground conduits and manholes, requiring a $250 deposit to ensure proper pavement repair and maintenance.

Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas December 24, 1914.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor: Roll called : Present Mayor Wooldridge,
Councilmen Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
The minutes of the last regular and subsequent recessed meetings were read and adopted:
The Mayor laid before the Council the report of the Sanitary Inspector for the month of
November 1914, which was read and ordered filed :

Mary Johnson
Fine Suspended
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin : That the balance of the fine ,to-wit, $ 12.80 ,owing by Mary Johnson in
cause No 8980, State of Texas vs Mary Johnson in the Corporation Court of the City of
Austin ,Texas, be and the same is hereby suspended, pending the good behavior of the said
Mary Johnson: The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,
Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved , A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Bessie Gray
Fine Suspended
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin : That the payment of the balance of the fine ,to-wit, $ 61.80, owing by
Bessie Gray in cause No 8983, State of Texas vs Bessie Gray in the Corporation Court of
the City of Austin, Texas, be and the same is hereby suspended ,pending the good behavior,
of the said Bessie Gray.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew ,Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Lillie Fields
Fine Suspended
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin : That the balance of the fine, to-wit, $ 4.80, owing by Lillie Fields in
cause No 9032, State of Texas vs Lillie Fields in the Corporation Court of the City of
Austin, Texas, be and the same is hereby suspended, pending the good behavior of the said
Lillie Fields.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor .

Julia Hubbard
Fine Suspended
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin : That the balance of the fine, to-wit, $ 31.80, owing by Julia Hubbard in
cause No 9036, State of Texas vs Julia Hubbard in the Corporation Court of the City of
Austin, Texas, be and the same is hereby suspended ,pending the good behavior of the said
Julia Hubbard.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor

Dec 28th 1914: All present Except Councilman Anthony. 178

(appro Sewer certificates)
. Councilman Powell offered the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin: That the sum of $ 15.00 be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the
Sewer Earnings fund of the City of Austin, Texas, in payment of exchange upon $ 12, 000.00
of money and made payable to the Citizens Bank & Trust Co of the City of Austin, Texas,
for remitting $ 12.000.00to the Chase National Bank of New York City in payment of one
sewer Certificate of $ 10,000.00,& $ 2,000.00 interest upon the sewer Certificate debt of
the City of Austin,Texas The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor
Wooldridge, Councilmen Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

(Exchange City Bonds Int)
Councilman Haynes offered the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin: That the sum of $ 59.52,be and the same is hereby segregated out of the
Interest & Sinking fund of the City of Austin, Texas, in favor of the Citizens Bank &
Trust Co and directed to be applied to the cost of exchange upon $ 47, 615.00, as
semi-annual interest owing by the City of Austin and due January 1st 1915, on its various
issues of bonds.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

(Jno A Darter Overflow Land)
Councilman Bartholomew offered the following resolution: Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin: That the City Clerk be and he is hereby authorized to issue
the warrant of the City of Austin for the sum of three hundred ($ 300.00) dollars, pay
able out of th the amount heretofore appropriated by the budget of the Water, Light and
Power department of the City of Austin for the year 1914, to purchase overflow`rights,
said warrant payable to the order of John A Darter,; and the Mayor is hereby authorized
and instructed to sign said warrant and deliver the same to said John A Darter upon the
delivery to the City of Austin by him of the deed of himself and his Wife to the City of
Austin, conveying the perpetual right to overflow certain tracts of his land by the waters
of the Colorado River which may be impounded by the Dam now being constructed across said
river, said property being described in said deed of date December 26th 1914.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Abeseny Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.


 --- Page break --- 

Wm P. R. Cu
To open pavement
for Conduits

Councilman Powell offered the following resolution :

Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas : That the Western Union
Telegraph Company be and is hereby granted permission to open pavements and install
conduits and manholes on West 6th street and on Colorado street as follows : Cut and
Conduit to begin on the north side of W 6th street in front of No 122, thence to run in a
course directly across said street for a distance of approximately 15 fe feet to the
center of a manhole to be constructed; from this manhole out and conduit to run westwardly
parallel with the center line of said West 6th street a distance of approximately 112 feet
to the center of manhole to be constructed, which manhole is to be located approximately
on the east curb line of Colorado street; from this manhole out and conduit to run
southward along Colorado street and across said West 6th street a distance of
approximately 97 feet to a pole now located on the east curb line of Colorado street .
Cuts for trenches not to exceed 24 inches in width and conduit to be laid at such a depth
as will clear existing conduits and pipe lines.
That the Western Union Telegraph Company shall be held liable for any damages to property
or personal injuries that may occur due to the prosecution of this work , and that said
Western Union Telegraph Company shall deposite with the Mayor of the City of Austin a
certified check in the amount of $ 250.00, guaranteeing the replace-ment of paving in
first class condition ,and the maintenance of same for a period of five years.
That no work in the street shall be started until special permission is obtained from the
Supt of streets and that all paving work shall be done under the supervision and with the
approval of the City Engineer and that the street shall at all times be kept open for
traffic .
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin: That the sum of $ 80.00, be and the same is hereby appropriated out
of the General Contingent fund of the City of Austin, Texas, for the year 1914, to pay the
salary of Geo Pendexter as Driver of the Hook & Ladder No 1, for the month of December
1914, Be it further resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That the sum of $
70.00, be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the General Contin-gent fund of the
City of Austin, for the year 1914, to pay the salary of Arthur Quist as Asst Driver for
Hook & Ladder Nol The resolution was adopted by the following vote : apprvd Salaries
attd Dec 1
Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

The Council then adjourned.
Jno. Johnson
City Clerk
